categories.main_business_segments: TST Group Holding Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing, processing, and sales of knitted fabrics, especially cotton blended knitted fabrics. The company also deals in garment manufacturing and trading of yarn and related raw materials. Its product portfolio includes sweatshirt fabrics, plain knitted fabrics, and innovative air-layer fabrics used mainly in sportswear, casual wear, and fashion apparel.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced textile technologies including plasma treatment for dyeing, liquid wax low-water dyeing processes, and new knitting structure design with simulation modeling. It focuses on environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production methods, such as low-bath ratio dyeing vats and no-water dyeing processes. The firm also develops digital fabric databases and integrates 3D digitalization for product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TST serves major international sports and casual wear brands such as adidas, PUMA, GAP, and NIKE. Its customers are primarily garment manufacturers contracted by these brands. The company targets global markets with a focus on North America, Europe, and Asia, supplying high-quality functional and fashionable knitted fabrics for sportswear and athleisure apparel.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Vietnam, Cambodia, and China, with sales and management offices in Hong Kong and Taiwan. Its sales markets include Southeast Asia, South Asia, China, and significant exports to the United States and Europe. The company benefits from regional trade agreements like RCEP and various FTAs involving Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: TST operates mainly in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on fabric manufacturing and processing. It sources yarn and raw materials upstream and supplies finished knitted fabrics downstream to garment manufacturers and brand owners. The company also manages integrated production including weaving, dyeing, finishing, and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes regionalized supply chains to mitigate geopolitical risks and enhance flexibility. It invests in R&D for eco-friendly dyeing technologies, functional and high-value-added fabrics, and digitalization of fabric data. Plans include establishing an R&D center in Vietnam to develop market-driven, sustainable textile products with improved appearance, quality, and performance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of knitted fabrics and garments. The company also earns from processing and trading yarn and related raw materials. Its business model relies on contract manufacturing and long-term supply agreements with international sports and casual wear brands.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TST competes in the global textile industry, particularly in the niche of high-quality knitted fabrics for sportswear and athleisure. It holds a competitive position due to its integrated production capabilities, multiple regional manufacturing bases, and strong relationships with leading international brands. The company differentiates itself through innovation, quality control, and supply chain flexibility.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, TST reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$5.42 billion, a 4.44% increase from 2023. However, net profit declined by 83.92% to NT$66 million due to startup costs at the new Vietnam factory and increased fixed costs. The company has a workforce of over 2,100 employees and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, indicating a growth-oriented but currently challenged financial profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TST emphasizes high-quality, functional, and environmentally sustainable knitted fabrics tailored to international sports and casual wear brands. Its value proposition includes rapid response to market demands, diversified regional production to ensure supply chain stability, and advanced textile technologies that enhance fabric performance and eco-friendliness. The company’s strong quality management system and brand certifications further differentiate its products.
